summary: This document defines TEAP version 1, a tunnel-based EAP method. It uses TLS to set up a mutually authenticated tunnel between a peer and a server, and carries TLV objects inside the tunnel. It was later replaced by RFC 9930.

eli5.summary: First you build a private tunnel to a gatekeeper, then you pass your proof of identity inside it where no one can see. It has since been replaced by RFC 9930.
